Trusted by global leading companies.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Built with Agentic DNA from Day One.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Powering growth through software-to-software agents.
 
 
 Appier’s vision for agentic AI began nearly two decades ago with CEO Chih-Han Yu’s award-winning doctoral research at Harvard on multi-agent systems. Today, this vision is brought to life by a world-class R&D team, where 70% hold PhDs or Master’s degrees in AI and Big Data, with over 400 academic publications. Appier powers our Ad Agent, Personalization Agent, and Data Agent to help businesses grow smarter, faster, and more efficiently.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
An AI-native AdTech and MarTech Company
 
Powered by machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, and proprietary algorithms, Appier’s vision is to make AI easy by making software intelligent, delivering world-class marketing solutions that drive measurable growth and empower our clients.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Appier's Three AI Clouds
 
Autonomous, Adaptive, and Agentic.

High-ROAS user acquisition from Day 1
 
Nexon deployed AIBID user acquisition and re-engagement solution to identify and target the most valuable gamers for its titles. From Day 1 of a game’s launch, AIBID has been able to successfully acquire high-ROAS users who will play the game long-term and make in-app purchases.

UA for idle tower defense game
 
GameDuo used Appier's Ad Cloud for in-app data, forming new user profiles and leveraging AI for targeting during the campaign, resulting in a remarkable 41% conversion boost.
 
 
 
Learn More
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
High-ROAS success in EMEA casual game
 
Get Color's campaign for its hyper-casual game spanned 5 countries, focusing on high-value gamers with optimized content to achieve remarkable ROAS and CPI reduction.
 
 
 
Learn More
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Virtual PC game user acquisition strategy
 
The Sandbox employed Appier’s Ad Cloud in Hong Kong and Taiwan for Alpha Season 3, expanding their audience and increasing engagement, notably raising the season's CTR.

Premier Japanese Automotive Manufacturer
 
Toyota Philippines approached Appier with a KPI of driving site traffic to 44,073 visits in a month. Using audience targeting, geo-targeting, topic targeting and cross-screen targeting, Appier increased traffic to the site by threefold, compared to overall site traffic prior to the campaign.
 
 
 
Learn More
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
World-Famous German Automobile Brand
 
Audi applied Appier’s AI to identify all the devices owned by its target audiences for cross-screen targeting. It also used Frequency Capping to deliver more ad exposure to the devices most likely to be used by users to sign up for the test drive, while avoiding ad fatigue.

 High-value user targeting for maximum ROAS
 
 
 AIBID predicts high-value users through behavioral patterns, engagement signals, and purchase intent. Using contextual targeting, our deep learning models analyze user profiles, site interactions, and in-app behavior to identify profitable audiences in real-time and secure optimal bids. Capturing positive signals from day one accelerates model learning for faster optimization and better performance.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 AI-driven optimization across high-quality inventories
 
 
 AIBID dynamically allocates budgets across premium, high-intent inventories while maintaining 100% transparency. By analyzing user behavior and ad interactions, AIBID optimizes bidding strategies to drive the best conversion rates. With hourly bid adjustments and priority inventories, it ensures ads appear at the right time and place for maximum impact.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Dynamic creatives for stronger engagement
 
 
 AIBID personalizes ad experiences with dynamic creatives and GenAI-generated content, tailoring ads to user intent. By matching creative formats to user value tiers, it delivers the right message to the target audience, boosting CTR and conversions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Supercharge your Ads with GenAI-powered creativity!
 
 
 AdCreative.ai is now part of Appier Group, bringing you even more AI-driven creative optimization to boost performance and scale your campaigns effortlessly. Get ready for higher ROAS, smarter automation, and dynamic ad experiences—all powered by Generative AI.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Discover what’s next 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
After implementing Appier's AIBID solution, our app's growth soared to new heights. The platform's ability to generate great installs right from Day 1 was impressive, and we experienced a consistent stream of high-quality users with excellent retention rates. What truly impressed us was how AIBID helped us achieve the ROAS targets we had in place. AIBID has become an integral part of our user acquisition strategy, and we eagerly anticipate the continued success it will bring to other game titles.
 
 
 
 WooChang Lee 
 
 
 Deputy Department Manager, NEXON
